mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id, binding_id, revision, agent_id, source_kind, source_id, content_digest, endpoint, model_id, encrypted_credential, strategy_id, strategy_version, response_formats, image_policy, streaming, reasoning, timeout, binding_format_version, provider_id, service_id, profile_version, protocol, authentication_scheme, dialect_version, system_updates_in_history, tool_update_mode, retain_tools_with_tool_choice_none FROM public.agent_runtime_model_bindings WHERE tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AND binding_id = #{binding} ORDER BY revision DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT tenant_id, binding_id, revision, agent_id, source_kind, source_id, content_digest, endpoint, model_id, encrypted_credential, strategy_id, strategy_version, response_formats, image_policy, streaming, reasoning, timeout, binding_format_version, provider_id, service_id, profile_version, protocol, authentication_scheme, dialect_version, system_updates_in_history, tool_update_mode, retain_tools_with_tool_choice_none FROM public.agent_runtime_model_bindings WHERE tenant_id = current_setting('app.tenant_id', true) AND binding_id = #{binding} AND revision = #{revision}
